## Pilot study in area B

We first looked at a 4 km by 4 km area near Coimbra, Portugal. The yellow line on the first map shows the main road we selected.

```{r}
#| message: false
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyterra)

photo_2018 <- rast("Raw Data/dgt_ortho2018_context.tif")
photo_2025 <- rast("Raw Data/dgt_ortho2025_context.tif")
land_cover <- read_sf("Raw Data/cos2018_land_cover.geojson")
forest_2018 <- read_sf("Raw Data/cos2018_eucalyptus.geojson")
forest_2025 <- read_sf("Raw Data/cos2025_eucalyptus.geojson")
road <- read_sf("Raw Data/cos2018_roads.geojson") %>%
  filter(ogc_fid == 147070)

# Crop the climate data to the pilot area.
area <- as.polygons(ext(photo_2018), crs = crs(photo_2018))
window <- project(area, "EPSG:4326")
climate_file <- "Raw Data/PRT_wc2.1_30s_bio.tif"
climate_url <- paste0(
  "https://geodata.ucdavis.edu/climate/worldclim/2_1/tiles/iso/",
  "PRT_wc2.1_30s_bio.tif")
if (!file.exists(climate_file)) {
  download.file(climate_url, climate_file, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
}
climate <- rast(climate_file)[[c(1, 12)]] %>%
  crop(window, snap = "out")
names(climate) <- c("temperature", "precipitation")
```

Four fields from the 2018 land-cover map are shown below.

```{r}
land_cover %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(id = ogc_fid, cover_code = cos18v4_n4_c, cover_name = cos18v4_n4_l, area_ha) %>%
  glimpse(width = 68)
```

```{r}
draw_map <- function(photo, layer, title) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_spatraster_rgb(data = photo, interpolate = FALSE,
                        maxcell = ncell(photo)) +
    layer +
    coord_sf(crs = 3763, datum = st_crs(3763), expand = FALSE,
             xlim = c(xmin(photo), xmax(photo)),
             ylim = c(ymin(photo), ymax(photo))) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Easting (m)", y = "Northing (m)") +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

```{r}
#| out-width: 5.2in
#| fig-align: center
draw_map(photo_2018,
         geom_sf(data = road, fill = "#FFD166", colour = NA),
         "Selected main road, 2018")
```

```{r}

         geom_sf(data = forest_2018, fill = "#00BFE8",
                 colour = NA, alpha = 0.4),

```


```{r}

cells <- as.polygons(climate, aggregate = FALSE, round = FALSE) %>%
  st_as_sf()
draw_map(photo_2025,
         geom_sf(data = cells, aes(fill = temperature),
                 colour = "white", alpha = 0.55),

```

## Regional eucalyptus forest cover

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
input <- function(name) file.path("Raw Data", name)
study_area <- st_read(input("land_cover.gpkg"), "study_area", quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_geometry()
```

```{r}
#| label: prepare-forest-maps
#| include: false
forest_in_region <- function(year) {
  forest <- st_read(input("land_cover.gpkg"), layer = paste0("euc", year), quiet = TRUE)
  inside <- st_intersection(st_geometry(forest), st_geometry(study_area))
  st_union(inside[st_dimension(inside) == 2])
}

forest18 <- forest_in_region(2018)
forest25 <- forest_in_region(2025)
changes <- st_sf(
  cover = c("Retained", "Gained", "Lost"),
  geometry = c(st_intersection(forest18, forest25),
               st_difference(forest25, forest18),
               st_difference(forest18, forest25))
)
areas_ha <- function(x) as.numeric(st_area(x)) / 10000
forest_area_ha <- c("2018" = areas_ha(forest18), "2025" = areas_ha(forest25),
                    setNames(areas_ha(changes), c("Retained", "Gain", "Loss")))
hectares <- function(x) paste0(format(round(x), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), " ha")

map_forest <- function(features, colours, heading, detail) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = study_area, aes(fill = "Other cover"), colour = NA) +
    geom_sf(data = features, aes(fill = cover), colour = NA) +
    geom_sf(data = study_area, fill = NA, colour = "grey48", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = colours, breaks = names(colours)) +
    coord_sf(datum = st_crs(4326), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(title = heading, subtitle = detail, x = NULL, y = NULL,
         caption = "Central Portugal  |  North up  |  Map width about 34 km") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.key = element_rect(colour = "grey78", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2),
          plot.title.position = "plot", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
          plot.caption.position = "plot", plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))
}

annual_colours <- c("Eucalyptus forest" = "#286850", "Other cover" = "#F7F6F1")
annual_map <- function(forest, year) {
  features <- st_sf(cover = "Eucalyptus forest", geometry = forest)
  map_forest(features, annual_colours, paste("Eucalyptus forest in", year),
             paste("Mapped forest area:", hectares(forest_area_ha[year])))
}
change_detail <- paste("Gained", hectares(forest_area_ha["Gain"]), " |  Lost",
                       hectares(forest_area_ha["Loss"]), " |  Retained",
                       hectares(forest_area_ha["Retained"]))
maps <- list(
  "2018" = annual_map(forest18, "2018"),
  "2025" = annual_map(forest25, "2025"),
  "change" = map_forest(changes,
    c("Gained" = "#006792", "Lost" = "#BF430D", "Retained" = "#CED9CC",
      "Other cover" = "#F7F6F1"),
    "Eucalyptus forest change, 2018 to 2025", change_detail)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: forest-2018
#| echo: false
#| dev: pdf
#| fig-width: 6.6
#| fig-height: 6.9
maps[["2018"]]
```

Green shows forest mapped as mainly eucalyptus in 2018. The study area is near Coimbra in central Portugal (8.50–8.10°W, 40.025–40.325°N).

## Environment table

```{r}
#| label: environmental-locations
#| include: false
bounds <- st_bbox(study_area)
centres <- function(lo, hi) seq(floor(lo / 80) * 80 + 40, hi, by = 80)
sites <- expand.grid(x_m = centres(bounds["xmin"], bounds["xmax"]),
                     y_m = centres(bounds["ymin"], bounds["ymax"])) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x_m", "y_m"), crs = 3763, remove = FALSE)
sites <- sites[lengths(st_within(sites, study_area)) > 0, ]

land18 <- st_read(input("land_cover.gpkg"), "land2018", quiet = TRUE)
hit <- st_intersects(sites, land18)
land_row <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sites))
unique_hit <- lengths(hit) == 1L
land_row[unique_hit] <- unlist(hit[unique_hit], use.names = FALSE)

fires <- st_read(input("fires.gpkg"), "fires", quiet = TRUE)
in_fire_2017 <- lengths(st_intersects(sites, filter(fires, year == 2017))) > 0
in_fire_2018_25 <- lengths(st_intersects(sites, filter(fires, between(year, 2018, 2025)))) > 0
```

```{r}
#| label: sample-environmental-rasters
#| include: false
at_sites <- function(layer, cells = FALSE) {
  xy <- st_transform(sites, crs(layer)) %>% st_coordinates()
  terra::extract(layer, xy, cells = cells)
}
regional_climate <- at_sites(rast(input("climate.tif")), cells = TRUE)
dsm <- rast(input("copernicus_glo30.tif"))
# Keep surrounding source cells for slope at the edge of the study window.
terrain_bounds <- ext(vect(st_transform(study_area, crs(dsm))))
dsm <- crop(dsm, extend(terrain_bounds, 2 * res(dsm)[1]), snap = "out")
slope <- terrain(dsm, v = "slope", unit = "degrees", neighbors = 8)
terrain_values <- at_sites(c(dsm, slope))
dnbr <- at_sites(rast(input("fire_dnbr_2017.tif")))[[1]]
suitability <- at_sites(rast(input("fire_confidence_2017.tif")))[[1]]

management <- rast(input("forest_management_2015.tif"))
management_code <- at_sites(management)[[1]]
planted <- ifel(management == 31 | management == 32, 1, NA)
planted_cells <- as.polygons(planted, dissolve = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>% st_transform(3763) %>% st_geometry()
nearest <- st_nearest_feature(sites, planted_cells)
planted_m <- as.numeric(st_distance(st_geometry(sites), planted_cells[nearest],
                                    by_element = TRUE))
crop_edge <- as.polygons(management, extent = TRUE) %>% st_as_sf() %>%
  st_transform(3763) %>% st_boundary()
edge_m <- as.numeric(st_distance(sites, crop_edge))
```

```{r}
#| label: write-environment-table
#| include: false
environment <- sites %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(site_id = paste(x_m, y_m, sep = "_"), .before = 1) %>%
  mutate(cos_2018_code = land18$cover_code[land_row],
         cos_2018_label = land18$cover_name[land_row],
         chelsa_cell = regional_climate$cell, temp_mean_c = regional_climate$temp_c,
         precip_annual_mm = regional_climate$precip_mm, wind_speed_ms = regional_climate$wind_speed_ms,
         elevation_m = terrain_values[[1]],
         slope_deg = terrain_values[[2]], burned_perimeter_2017 = in_fire_2017,
         dnbr_2017 = dnbr, image_suitability_2017_pct = suitability,
         management_2015_code = management_code,
         planted_forest_2015_m = if_else(planted_m <= edge_m, planted_m, NA_real_),
         burned_perimeter_2018_2025 = in_fire_2018_25)
readr::write_csv(environment, "environment.csv", na = "")
```

Each row in `environment.csv` is one point on the 80 m grid. This was our first environmental overview. The updated comparisons below use actual land areas, organised in 20 m cells. Nearby locations can share the same climate value.



\newpage

## Updated roads

We kept the comparable **2018 and 2025** forest maps and rebuilt the roads from the **January 2018** OpenStreetMap archive. We now include 17,113 mapped line segments in the study area and its distance buffer. Segments are not separate whole roads.

| Group | Included routes | Segments |
|:--|:--|--:|
| Traffic roads | Motorways, trunk, primary, secondary and tertiary roads and their links; minor connecting, residential and living-street roads | 11,308 |
| Land-access routes | 4,206 tracks plus 1,599 service segments, including driveways, alleys and service routes without a subtype | 5,805 |

Private and agricultural access restrictions do not remove a physical route, so these routes remain. We exclude parking aisles, drive-through lanes, footpaths, cycleways, steps, pedestrian streets, raceways, unknown road types and unfinished routes. This is a definition for this study; it does not mean the excluded routes have no ecological effect.

**A service road is not necessarily a forest road.** Of the 1,182 service segments without a subtype, 48% of their length inside the study area crosses artificial surfaces in the 2018 map, and about 26% crosses forests. We therefore call the second group land-access routes. We check results with only tracks, without unknown service subtypes, and without the 29 segments explicitly tagged as closed to motor vehicles.

The two road distances enter the model together. Each contrast changes one road distance while keeping the other observed. The archive can miss routes, and it does not measure traffic or the exact construction date.

**Our original predictions.** Result 1 asks whether comparable land gains more eucalyptus near roads. Result 2 asks whether gain declines less with distance from old eucalyptus near roads. Both test the broader hypothesis that roads favour forest expansion. Result 3 is an added exploration of pine-to-eucalyptus change in fire footprints.

```{r}
#| label: selected-cache-setup
#| include: false
library(fixest)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(jsonlite)
setFixest_nthreads(2)
# Raw-file fingerprints keep the working cache tied to these exact inputs.
cache_key <- digest::digest(list(version = "selected-roads-v1", files = tools::md5sum(list.files("Raw Data", full.names = TRUE))))
analysis_cache <- file.path("_cache", cache_key)
dir.create(analysis_cache, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
env_file <- file.path(analysis_cache, "env.tif")
if (!file.exists(env_file)) {
  grid20 <- rast(xmin = 20 * floor(bounds["xmin"] / 20), xmax = 20 * ceiling(bounds["xmax"] / 20),
    ymin = 20 * floor(bounds["ymin"] / 20), ymax = 20 * ceiling(bounds["ymax"] / 20),
    resolution = 20, crs = "EPSG:3763")
  align20 <- function(x) terra::project(x, grid20, method = "near")
  env20 <- c(align20(c(dsm, slope)), align20(rast(input("climate.tif"))), align20(management),
    rasterize(vect(filter(fires, year == 2017)), grid20, field = 1, background = 0),
    align20(rast(input("fire_dnbr_2017.tif"))), align20(rast(input("fire_confidence_2017.tif"))))
  names(env20) <- c("elevation", "slope", "temperature", "rain", "wind", "management", "burned", "severity", "quality")
  writeRaster(env20, env_file, datatype = "FLT4S")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: selected-area-preparation
#| include: false
# Requires input(name), analysis_cache, and env_file from the QMD setup.
# Raw layers: land_cover.gpkg (2018 land, 2018/2025 eucalypt, study area)
# and roads2018_selected.gpkg (layer roads). All processing uses EPSG:3763.
if (!file.exists(file.path(analysis_cache, "data", "analysis_data.rds"))) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(sf); library(terra); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr); library(jsonlite)
  })
  out <- file.path(analysis_cache, "data")
  dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  env <- rast(env_file)
  grid <- env[[1]]
  stands <- read_sf(input("land_cover.gpkg"), "euc2018") %>% arrange(source_id)
  study <- read_sf(input("land_cover.gpkg"), "study_area")

  cache <- function(file, make) {
    path <- file.path(out, file)
    if (file.exists(path)) readRDS(path) else {
      value <- make()
      saveRDS(value, path)
      value
    }
  }

  areas <- cache("eligible_geometry.rds", function() {
    message("Building the unique 200 m forest neighbourhood")
    forest <- st_union(st_geometry(stands))
    window <- st_union(st_buffer(st_geometry(stands), 200, nQuadSegs = 30)) %>%
      st_intersection(st_geometry(study)) %>% st_difference(forest)
    land <- read_sf(input("land_cover.gpkg"), "land2018") %>%
      filter(substr(cover_code, 1, 1) %in% as.character(2:6), cover_code != "5.1.1.6") %>%
      rename(land_id = source_id) %>% select(land_id, cover_code)
    st_intersection(land, window) %>% st_collection_extract("POLYGON", warn = FALSE) %>%
      filter(as.numeric(st_area(.)) > 1e-7) %>% mutate(area_row = row_number())
  })

  gains <- cache("gain_geometry.rds", function() {
    message("Intersecting eligible land with mapped eucalyptus in 2025")
    new_forest <- read_sf(input("land_cover.gpkg"), "euc2025") %>% st_geometry() %>% st_union()
    st_intersection(areas, new_forest) %>% st_collection_extract("POLYGON", warn = FALSE) %>%
      filter(as.numeric(st_area(.)) > 1e-7)
  })

  area_cells <- function(features) {
    batches <- split(seq_len(nrow(features)), (seq_len(nrow(features)) - 1L) %/% 150L)
    bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(batches), function(j) {
      f <- features[batches[[j]], ]
      hit <- terra::extract(grid, vect(f), cells = TRUE, exact = TRUE)
      if (j %% 10L == 0L) message("Exact area extraction batch ", j, "/", length(batches))
      tibble(area_row = f$area_row[hit$ID], cell = hit$cell, m2 = 400 * hit$fraction)
    })) %>% filter(is.finite(m2), m2 > 1e-8) %>%
      group_by(area_row, cell) %>% summarise(m2 = sum(m2), .groups = "drop")
  }

  tab <- cache("exact_areas.rds", function() {
    message("Extracting eligible cell fractions")
    eligible <- area_cells(areas) %>% rename(eligible_m2 = m2)
    message("Extracting gain cell fractions")
    gain <- area_cells(gains) %>% rename(gain_m2 = m2)
    left_join(eligible, gain, by = c("area_row", "cell")) %>%
      mutate(gain_m2 = replace_na(gain_m2, 0)) %>%
      left_join(st_drop_geometry(areas), by = "area_row")
  })

  locations <- cache("representative_locations.rds", function() {
    xy <- xyFromCell(grid, tab$cell)
    location <- tibble(x_m = xy[, 1], y_m = xy[, 2], location_method = "cell_centre")
    # Full cells are interior; inspect partial cells against their own eligible polygon.
    pending <- which(tab$eligible_m2 < 400 - 1e-7)
    inside <- function(ids, x, y) {
      points <- st_as_sf(data.frame(x, y), coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 3763)
      hit <- st_intersects(points, areas)
      vapply(seq_along(ids), function(j) tab$area_row[ids[j]] %in% hit[[j]], logical(1))
    }
    ok <- inside(pending, location$x_m[pending], location$y_m[pending])
    pending <- pending[!ok]
    message("Partial rows with centres outside eligible land: ", length(pending))
    # Interior candidate points keep the representative within this 20 m cell.
    offsets <- expand.grid(dx = c(-7.5, -2.5, 2.5, 7.5), dy = c(-7.5, -2.5, 2.5, 7.5))
    offsets <- offsets[order(offsets$dx^2 + offsets$dy^2), ]
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(offsets))) {
      if (!length(pending)) break
      x <- xy[pending, 1] + offsets$dx[j]
      y <- xy[pending, 2] + offsets$dy[j]
      ok <- inside(pending, x, y)
      location$x_m[pending[ok]] <- x[ok]
      location$y_m[pending[ok]] <- y[ok]
      location$location_method[pending[ok]] <- "interior_sample"
      pending <- pending[!ok]
    }
    message("Thin boundary rows needing exact interior point: ", length(pending))
    if (length(pending)) {
      ids <- unique(tab$cell[pending])
      centres <- xyFromCell(grid, ids)
      boxes <- lapply(seq_along(ids), function(j) {
        x <- centres[j, 1]; y <- centres[j, 2]
        st_polygon(list(matrix(c(x-10,y-10,x+10,y-10,x+10,y+10,x-10,y+10,x-10,y-10),
                               ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)))
      })
      cells <- st_sf(cell = ids, geometry = st_sfc(boxes, crs = 3763))
      fragments <- st_intersection(cells, areas[unique(tab$area_row[pending]), "area_row"])
      fragments <- fragments[st_dimension(fragments) == 2, ]
      fragments <- fragments %>% mutate(fragment_m2 = as.numeric(st_area(.))) %>%
        group_by(cell, area_row) %>% slice_max(fragment_m2, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()
      point <- st_point_on_surface(fragments)
      point_xy <- st_coordinates(point)
      key <- paste(tab$cell[pending], tab$area_row[pending])
      k <- match(key, paste(point$cell, point$area_row))
      stopifnot(!anyNA(k))
      location$x_m[pending] <- point_xy[k, 1]
      location$y_m[pending] <- point_xy[k, 2]
      location$location_method[pending] <- "fragment_surface_point"
    }
    location
  })

  nearest_distance <- function(points, features) {
    batches <- split(seq_len(nrow(points)), (seq_len(nrow(points)) - 1L) %/% 50000L)
    bind_rows(lapply(batches, function(i) {
      index <- st_nearest_feature(points[i, ], features)
      tibble(index = index,
             distance_m = as.numeric(st_length(st_nearest_points(st_geometry(points[i, ]),
                                      st_geometry(features)[index], pairwise = TRUE))))
    }))
  }

  base <- cache("baseline_table.rds", function() {
    message("Assigning each area row to one nearest baseline source")
    points <- st_as_sf(locations, coords = c("x_m", "y_m"), crs = 3763, remove = FALSE)
    closest <- nearest_distance(points, stands)
    environment <- terra::extract(env, tab$cell)
    bind_cols(tab, locations, environment) %>%
      mutate(source_id = stands$source_id[closest$index], source_m = closest$distance_m,
             gain_fraction = gain_m2 / eligible_m2)
  })

  # Exact polygon extraction can leave very small floating-point excesses.
  # Bound only these numerical area errors, not fitted model predictions.
  numerical_gain_excess <- max(tab$gain_m2 - tab$eligible_m2)
  stopifnot(numerical_gain_excess < 1e-5)
  base <- base %>% mutate(gain_m2 = pmin(gain_m2, eligible_m2),
                          gain_fraction = gain_m2 / eligible_m2)
  saveRDS(base, file.path(out, "baseline_table.rds"))

  qa <- list(rows = nrow(base), cells = n_distinct(base$cell),
             eligible_ha = sum(base$eligible_m2) / 10000,
             gain_ha = sum(base$gain_m2) / 10000,
             geometry_eligible_ha = sum(as.numeric(st_area(areas))) / 10000,
             geometry_gain_ha = sum(as.numeric(st_area(gains))) / 10000,
             cell_max_eligible_m2 = max(tapply(base$eligible_m2, base$cell, sum)),
             largest_gain_excess_m2 = max(base$gain_m2 - base$eligible_m2),
             original_numerical_gain_excess_m2 = numerical_gain_excess,
             corrected_floating_point_rows = sum(tab$gain_m2 > tab$eligible_m2),
             min_source_distance_m = min(base$source_m),
             max_source_distance_m = max(base$source_m),
             sources = n_distinct(base$source_id),
             location_methods = as.list(table(base$location_method)))
  write_json(qa, file.path(out, "baseline_qa.json"), auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
  stopifnot(qa$largest_gain_excess_m2 < 1e-5,
            qa$cell_max_eligible_m2 <= 400 + 1e-4,
            abs(qa$eligible_ha - qa$geometry_eligible_ha) < 1e-4,
            abs(qa$gain_ha - qa$geometry_gain_ha) < 1e-4,
            qa$min_source_distance_m >= 0,
            qa$max_source_distance_m <= 200 + 0.1)
  message("Baseline table ready at ", file.path(out, "baseline_table.rds"))

  table <- base
  original_names <- names(table)
  roads <- read_sf(input("roads2018_selected.gpkg"), "roads")
  points <- st_as_sf(table %>% select(x_m, y_m), coords = c("x_m", "y_m"), crs = 3763)
  traffic <- roads %>% filter(group == "traffic")
  access <- roads %>% filter(group == "access")

  nearest <- function(p, features) {
    batches <- split(seq_len(nrow(p)), (seq_len(nrow(p)) - 1L) %/% 50000L)
    bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(batches), function(j) {
      ids <- batches[[j]]
      index <- st_nearest_feature(p[ids, ], features)
      if (j %% 5L == 0L) message("Distance batch ", j, "/", length(batches))
      segment <- st_nearest_points(st_geometry(p[ids, ]),
                                   st_geometry(features)[index], pairwise = TRUE)
      tibble(index, distance_m = as.numeric(st_length(segment)))
    }))
  }
  cache <- function(name, make) {
    path <- file.path(out, paste0(name, ".rds"))
    if (file.exists(path)) readRDS(path) else {
      value <- make(); saveRDS(value, path); value
    }
  }
  restricted_distance <- function(full, network, keep, name) {
    cache(name, function() {
      value <- full$distance_m
      needs <- which(!keep[full$index])
      message(name, ": recalculating ", length(needs), " rows")
      if (length(needs)) value[needs] <- nearest(points[needs, ], network[keep, ])$distance_m
      value
    })
  }
  message("Traffic distances")
  traffic_dist <- cache("traffic_distance", function() nearest(points, traffic))
  message("Land-access distances")
  access_dist <- cache("access_distance", function() nearest(points, access))
  table$traffic_m <- traffic_dist$distance_m
  table$access_m <- access_dist$distance_m
  table$selected_m <- pmin(table$traffic_m, table$access_m)
  table$nearest_traffic_id <- traffic$osm_way_id[traffic_dist$index]
  table$nearest_access_id <- access$osm_way_id[access_dist$index]
  table$nearest_access_type <- access$highway[access_dist$index]
  table$nearest_access_subtype <- access$subtype[access_dist$index]
  message("Track distances")
  table$track_m <- cache("track_distance", function() nearest(points, filter(roads, highway == "track"))$distance_m)
  table$access_no_unknown_m <- restricted_distance(access_dist, access, !access$access_unknown,
                                                   "access_no_unknown_distance")
  table$traffic_motor_allowed_m <- restricted_distance(traffic_dist, traffic, !traffic$explicit_motor_no,
                                                        "traffic_motor_allowed_distance")
  table$access_motor_allowed_m <- restricted_distance(access_dist, access, !access$explicit_motor_no,
                                                      "access_motor_allowed_distance")
  table$selected_motor_allowed_m <- pmin(table$traffic_motor_allowed_m, table$access_motor_allowed_m)
  table$traffic_no_ban_m <- table$traffic_motor_allowed_m
  table$access_no_ban_m <- table$access_motor_allowed_m
  table$selected_no_ban_m <- table$selected_motor_allowed_m

  stopifnot(all(is.finite(table$traffic_m)), all(is.finite(table$access_m)),
            all(table$selected_m <= table$track_m + 1e-6),
            all(table$access_m <= table$access_no_unknown_m + 1e-6),
            all(table$traffic_m <= table$traffic_motor_allowed_m + 1e-6),
            all(table$access_m <= table$access_motor_allowed_m + 1e-6))
  saveRDS(table, file.path(out, "analysis_data.rds"))
  write_csv(table, file.path(out, "analysis_data.csv.gz"))
  distance_columns <- c("traffic_m", "access_m", "selected_m", "track_m", "access_no_unknown_m",
                        "traffic_no_ban_m", "access_no_ban_m", "selected_no_ban_m")
  summary <- bind_rows(lapply(distance_columns, function(column) {
    x <- table[[column]]
    tibble(network = column, min_m = min(x), median_m = median(x), max_m = max(x),
           rows_within_100m = sum(x <= 100), area_within_100m_ha = sum(table$eligible_m2[x <= 100]) / 10000)
  }))
  write_csv(summary, file.path(out, "distance_summary.csv"))
  write_json(list(rows = nrow(table), geometry_and_distance_pipeline = "Fresh rebuild from raw inputs",
                  row_order_preserved = TRUE, source_distances_preserved = TRUE,
                  eligible_area_ha = sum(table$eligible_m2) / 10000,
                  gain_area_ha = sum(table$gain_m2) / 10000,
                  original_source = "Raw Data/land_cover.gpkg; env_file; Raw Data/roads2018_selected.gpkg",
                  coordinate_system = "EPSG:3763",
                  distance = "Straight-line distance in metres from unchanged interior representative points to the nearest line in each predeclared network.",
                  track_distance = "Computed from all highway=track ways in roads2018_selected.gpkg.",
                  access_no_unknown = "Track plus service with an explicit service subtype; omitted parking_aisle and drive-through remain omitted.",
                  motor_allowed_caution = "Use traffic_no_ban_m/access_no_ban_m/selected_no_ban_m for analysis. Compatibility aliases *_motor_allowed_m mean only no explicit no in motorcar/motor_vehicle/vehicle. They do not establish legal access; private and general access=no routes remain possible.",
                  added_columns = setdiff(names(table), original_names)),
             file.path(out, "validation.json"), auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
  print(summary, width = Inf)
  message("Saved area and road-distance data.")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: selected-road-models
#| include: false
if (!file.exists(file.path(analysis_cache,"model/fit_status.json"))) {
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(readr); library(jsonlite)})

library(fixest)
setFixest_nthreads(2)
out <- file.path(analysis_cache,"model")
dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
data_file <- file.path(analysis_cache,"data/analysis_data.rds")
data <- readRDS(data_file)
weighted_quantile <- function(x, w, p) {
  k <- order(x)
  x[k][vapply(p, function(q) which(cumsum(w[k]) / sum(w) >= q)[1], integer(1))]
}
base <- data %>% mutate(
  area_ha = eligible_m2 / 10000, gain_fraction = gain_m2 / eligible_m2,
  stratum = paste(source_id, cover_code, sep = "_"),
  management_class = factor(case_when(is.na(management) ~ "Unknown",
    management %in% c(31, 32) ~ "Planted", TRUE ~ "Other")),
  burned = as.integer(burned > 0),
  severity_missing = as.integer(burned == 1 & (!is.finite(severity) | !is.finite(quality) | quality <= 0)),
  severity_value = if_else(burned == 1 & severity_missing == 0, severity, 0),
  elev100 = elevation / 100, slope10 = slope / 10, rain100 = rain / 100,
  block1 = paste(floor(x_m / 1000), floor(y_m / 1000)),
  block2 = paste(floor(x_m / 2000), floor(y_m / 2000)),
  block4 = paste(floor(x_m / 4000), floor(y_m / 4000)))
required <- c("elev100", "slope10", "temperature", "rain100", "wind", "burned", "source_m", "traffic_m", "access_m")
base$complete_environment <- apply(is.finite(as.matrix(base[required])), 1, all)
reference <- base %>% filter(source_m <= 100, area_ha > 0)
road_values <- bind_rows(lapply(c("traffic", "access"), function(g) {
  q <- weighted_quantile(reference[[paste0(g,"_m")]], reference$area_ha, c(.25,.5,.75))
  tibble(road=g, nearer_m=q[1], median_m=q[2], farther_m=q[3])
}))
write_csv(road_values, file.path(out,"road_reference.csv"))
write_json(list(primary="Two continuous road distances jointly; source by baseline cover fixed effects; actual area weights",
  road_types=c("Traffic roads", "Land-access routes, including service routes of unknown subtype"),
  reference="Baseline eligible land Q25/Q75; fixed across sensitivities; no outcome selection",
  source_window_m=100, wider_window_m=200, source_contrast_m=c(25,75),
  support="Within source by cover by other-road baseline quartile bin, focal road spans both quartiles. Result2: both road ends span source25 to75m.",
  limitations="Distance support is not exact environmental matching; common log-distance interaction; LPM is a projection, not a probability forecast",
  sensitivity=c("blocks1and4km", "window200", "track_only", "no_unknown_service", "no_explicit_motor_ban", "bounded_informative_subset", "leave_one_source_out")),
  file.path(out,"plan.json"), pretty=TRUE,auto_unbox=TRUE)
rm(reference,data); gc()

make_data <- function(window_m=100, traffic="traffic_m", access="access_m") {
  base %>% filter(source_m<=window_m,complete_environment,area_ha>0) %>%
    mutate(traffic_distance=.data[[traffic]], access_distance=.data[[access]],
      log_traffic=log1p(traffic_distance),log_access=log1p(access_distance),log_source=log1p(source_m))
}
formula <- gain_fraction ~ (log_traffic + log_access) * log_source + elev100 + slope10 +
  temperature + rain100 + wind + burned + severity_value + severity_missing + management_class | stratum

make_support <- function(d) {
  setNames(lapply(c("traffic","access"), function(g) {
    other <- if(g=="traffic") "access" else "traffic"
    q <- filter(road_values,road==g)
    oq <- filter(road_values,road==other)
    # Fixed baseline quartiles; ties are collapsed. Bins check support, not model matching.
    breaks <- unique(c(-Inf,oq$nearer_m,oq$median_m,oq$farther_m,Inf))
    z <- d %>% mutate(focal=.data[[paste0(g,"_distance")]],
      other_bin=as.integer(cut(.data[[paste0(other,"_distance")]],breaks=breaks,include.lowest=TRUE)),
      support_id=paste(stratum,other_bin,sep="__"))
    tab <- z %>% group_by(support_id,stratum,source_id,other_bin) %>% summarise(
      eligible_ha=sum(area_ha),gain_ha=sum(gain_m2)/10000,
      road_min=min(focal),road_max=max(focal),
      near_source_min=if(any(focal<=q$nearer_m)) min(source_m[focal<=q$nearer_m]) else Inf,
      near_source_max=if(any(focal<=q$nearer_m)) max(source_m[focal<=q$nearer_m]) else -Inf,
      far_source_min=if(any(focal>=q$farther_m)) min(source_m[focal>=q$farther_m]) else Inf,
      far_source_max=if(any(focal>=q$farther_m)) max(source_m[focal>=q$farther_m]) else -Inf,
      .groups="drop") %>% mutate(road_support=road_min<=q$nearer_m & road_max>=q$farther_m,
        both_support=road_support & near_source_min<=25 & near_source_max>=75 & far_source_min<=25 & far_source_max>=75)
    list(table=tab, index=list(
      `Result 1`=which(z$support_id %in% tab$support_id[tab$road_support]),
      `Result 2`=which(z$support_id %in% tab$support_id[tab$both_support])),breaks=breaks)
  }),c("traffic","access"))
}
contrast <- function(fit,d,s,g,result) {
  target <- d[s[[g]]$index[[result]],]
  q <- filter(road_values,road==g)
  v <- setNames(rep(0,length(coef(fit))),names(coef(fit)))
  dx <- log1p(q$nearer_m)-log1p(q$farther_m)
  main_name <- paste0("log_",g)
  interaction <- paste0(main_name,":log_source")
  stopifnot(main_name %in% names(v),interaction %in% names(v))
  if(nrow(target)>0) {
    if(result=="Result 1") {
      v[main_name] <- dx
      v[interaction] <- dx*weighted.mean(target$log_source,target$area_ha)
    } else v[interaction] <- dx*(log1p(75)-log1p(25))
  } else v[] <- NA_real_
  list(v=v,target=target)
}
effect <- function(fit,d,s,label,g,result,block="block2",logit=FALSE) {
  c <- contrast(fit,d,s,g,result); target <- c$target
  est_fraction <- se_fraction <- low <- high <- p <- NA_real_
  if(nrow(target)>0) {
    if(logit) {
      q <- filter(road_values,road==g)
      predicted_mean <- function(road,forest=NULL) {
        new <- target
        new[[paste0("log_",g)]] <- log1p(road)
        if(!is.null(forest)) new$log_source <- log1p(forest)
        weighted.mean(predict(fit,newdata=new,type="response"),target$area_ha)
      }
      est_fraction <- if(result=="Result 1") predicted_mean(q$nearer_m)-predicted_mean(q$farther_m) else
        (predicted_mean(q$nearer_m,75)-predicted_mean(q$nearer_m,25))-
        (predicted_mean(q$farther_m,75)-predicted_mean(q$farther_m,25))
    } else {
      V <- vcov(fit,vcov=as.formula(paste0("~source_id + ",block)))
      est_fraction <- sum(c$v*coef(fit))
      se_fraction <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(c$v)%*%V%*%c$v))
      df <- min(n_distinct(d$source_id),n_distinct(d[[block]]))-1
      low <- 100*(est_fraction-qt(.975,df)*se_fraction)
      high <- 100*(est_fraction+qt(.975,df)*se_fraction)
      p <- 2*pt(-abs(est_fraction/se_fraction),df)
    }
  }
  n_clusters <- min(n_distinct(d$source_id),n_distinct(d[[block]]))
  tibble(model=label,road=g,result=result,block=if(logit) "point estimate only" else block,
    estimate=100*est_fraction,low=low,high=high,scale="percentage points",
    reference_area_ha=sum(target$area_ha),reference_gain_ha=sum(target$gain_m2)/10000,
    reference_sources=n_distinct(target$source_id),reference_strata=n_distinct(target$stratum),
    clusters=n_clusters,p=p)
}
all_effects <- function(fit,d,s,label,block="block2",logit=FALSE) {
  bind_rows(lapply(c("traffic","access"),function(g) bind_rows(lapply(c("Result 1","Result 2"),
    function(r) effect(fit,d,s,label,g,r,block,logit)))))
}
diagnostic <- function(fit,d,label) {
  f <- fitted(fit)
  tibble(model=label,rows=nrow(d),area_ha=sum(d$area_ha),gain_ha=sum(d$gain_m2)/10000,
    sources=n_distinct(d$source_id),strata=n_distinct(d$stratum),blocks2=n_distinct(d$block2),
    weighted_outside_0_1_pct=100*weighted.mean(f<0|f>1,d$area_ha),
    fitted_min=min(f),fitted_max=max(f),dropped_terms=paste(fit$collin.var,collapse=";"))
}
message("Fitting joint traffic and land-access model")
d <- make_data(); s <- make_support(d)
for(g in names(s)) write_csv(s[[g]]$table,file.path(out,paste0(g,"_support.csv")))
main <- feols(formula,data=d,weights=~area_ha,vcov=~source_id+block2,demeaned=TRUE,fixef.rm="none",data.save=TRUE)
saveRDS(main,file.path(out,"main_model.rds"))
main_effects <- all_effects(main,d,s,"Joint roads, 100 m") %>% mutate(p_holm=p.adjust(p,"holm"))
write_csv(main_effects,file.path(out,"main_effects.csv")); print(main_effects,width=Inf)

  correlation=c(wc(d$log_traffic,d$log_access,d$area_ha),wc(wd$traffic_within,wd$access_within,wd$area_ha))),
  file.path(out,"distance_correlation.csv"))

settings <- list(window200=c("200","traffic_m","access_m"),
  track_only=c("100","traffic_m","track_m"),
  no_unknown=c("100","traffic_m","access_no_unknown_m"),
  no_motor_ban=c("100","traffic_no_ban_m","access_no_ban_m"))
labels <- c(window200="Joint roads, 200 m",track_only="Tracks as access routes",no_unknown="No unknown service subtype",no_motor_ban="No explicit motor bans")
for(setting in names(settings)) {
  a <- settings[[setting]]; ds <- make_data(as.numeric(a[1]),a[2],a[3]); ss <- make_support(ds)
  message("Fitting ",labels[setting])

  write_csv(tibble(term=names(coef(fit)),estimate=coef(fit)),file.path(out,paste0(setting,"_coefficients.csv")))
  rm(ds,ss,fit); gc()
}
info <- d %>% group_by(stratum) %>% summarise(eligible_ha=sum(area_ha),gain_ha=sum(gain_m2)/10000,.groups="drop") %>%
  filter(gain_ha>1e-9,gain_ha<eligible_ha-1e-9)
dg <- d %>% filter(stratum %in% info$stratum); sg <- make_support(dg)
message("Fitting bounded fractional logit on informative source-cover groups")
fractional <- feglm(formula,data=dg,family=quasibinomial(),weights=~area_ha,vcov=~source_id+block2,glm.iter=100,data.save=TRUE)
stopifnot(nobs(fractional)==nrow(dg))
saveRDS(fractional,file.path(out,"fractional_model.rds"))
effects <- bind_rows(effects,all_effects(fractional,dg,sg,"Fractional logit, informative land",logit=TRUE))
diagnostics <- bind_rows(diagnostics,diagnostic(fractional,dg,"Fractional logit, informative land"))
same <- feols(formula,data=dg,weights=~area_ha,vcov=~source_id+block2,fixef.rm="none",data.save=TRUE)
saveRDS(same,file.path(out,"same_sample_model.rds"))
effects <- bind_rows(effects,all_effects(same,dg,sg,"Linear model, same informative land"))
diagnostics <- bind_rows(diagnostics,diagnostic(same,dg,"Linear model, same informative land"))
write_csv(effects,file.path(out,"sensitivity_effects.csv"))
write_csv(diagnostics,file.path(out,"model_diagnostics.csv"))

X <- main$X_demeaned[,names(coef(main)),drop=FALSE]; y <- main$y_demeaned
Xw <- X*sqrt(d$area_ha); yw <- y*sqrt(d$area_ha)
A <- crossprod(Xw); b <- crossprod(Xw,yw)
vectors <- lapply(c("traffic","access"),function(g) lapply(c("Result 1","Result 2"),function(r) contrast(main,d,s,g,r)$v))
Vcontrast <- do.call(rbind,unlist(vectors,recursive=FALSE))
colnames(Vcontrast) <- names(coef(main))
rownames(Vcontrast) <- c("traffic_result1","traffic_result2","access_result1","access_result2")
groups <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)),d$source_id)
message("Whole-source influence check for ",length(groups)," sources")
loo <- bind_rows(lapply(names(groups),function(id) {
  k <- groups[[id]]
  beta <- tryCatch(solve(A-crossprod(Xw[k,,drop=FALSE]),b-crossprod(Xw[k,,drop=FALSE],yw[k])),
    error=function(e) rep(NA_real_,ncol(Xw)))
  vals <- as.numeric(100*Vcontrast%*%beta)
  tibble(omitted_source=id,traffic_result1=vals[1],traffic_result2=vals[2],access_result1=vals[3],access_result2=vals[4],omitted_area_ha=sum(d$area_ha[k]))
}))
write_csv(loo,file.path(out,"leave_one_source_out.csv"))
summary <- tibble(window_m=c(100,200)) %>% rowwise() %>% mutate(
  eligible_ha=sum(base$area_ha[base$source_m<=window_m]),gain_ha=sum(base$gain_m2[base$source_m<=window_m])/10000,
  incomplete_environment_ha=sum(base$area_ha[base$source_m<=window_m & !base$complete_environment]),
  sources=n_distinct(base$source_id[base$source_m<=window_m])) %>% ungroup()
write_csv(summary,file.path(out,"population.csv"))
raw_rates <- bind_rows(lapply(c("traffic","access"),function(g) {
  q <- filter(road_values,road==g)
  d %>% mutate(road=g,road_band=case_when(.data[[paste0(g,"_distance")]]<=q$nearer_m ~ "Near quarter",
    .data[[paste0(g,"_distance")]]>=q$farther_m ~ "Far quarter",TRUE ~ "Middle half"),
    source_band=cut(source_m,c(-Inf,25,50,75,100),labels=c("0-25","25-50","50-75","75-100"))) %>%
    group_by(road,road_band,source_band) %>% summarise(eligible_ha=sum(area_ha),gain_ha=sum(gain_m2)/10000,
      gain_pct=100*gain_ha/eligible_ha,.groups="drop")
}))
write_csv(raw_rates,file.path(out,"raw_distance_rates.csv"))
write_json(list(fixest_version=as.character(packageVersion("fixest")),fractional_converged=fractional$convStatus,
  fractional_removed_observations=nrow(dg)-nobs(fractional),linear_rows=nrow(d),logit_rows=nrow(dg),
  logit_omitted_area_ha=sum(d$area_ha)-sum(dg$area_ha),logit_sources=n_distinct(dg$source_id),
  logit_strata=n_distinct(dg$stratum),main_support_bins=lapply(s,function(x) x$breaks)),
  file.path(out,"fit_status.json"),auto_unbox=TRUE,pretty=TRUE)
message("Joint road models complete")

}
```

\newpage

## How we compare land

1. Start with every mapped **2018 eucalyptus source feature**, before looking at 2025 changes.
2. Measure eligible non-eucalyptus land within **100 m of the nearest source**: agriculture, pasture, agroforestry, other forest and shrub cover. Exclude artificial surfaces, bare land, wetlands and water. Use 200 m as a wider check. Count each piece of land once.
3. Divide this land into 20 m accounting cells, retaining the **actual area** of each original land-cover fragment. Use a point inside the fragment for distances and environmental values. The cell is not one tree, and it does not improve the accuracy of the original maps.
4. Model the fraction of each piece mapped as eucalyptus in 2025, weighted by its eligible area. Compare variation within the **same source feature and original land-cover class**. Also include source distance, both road distances, elevation, slope, temperature, rain, wind, measured 2017 fire history and the 2015 forest-management label.

The main model includes `r population$sources[1]` source features, `r sprintf("%.1f",population$eligible_ha[1])` ha of eligible land and `r sprintf("%.1f",population$gain_ha[1])` ha of mapped gain. Source features can touch or contain several parts; they are not necessarily separate biological stands.

**A fair comparison needs available land on both sides.** For each road type we compare the area-weighted lower and upper quarters of baseline road distance:

```{r}
#| label: road-reference-table
rv %>% transmute(Road=recode(road,!!!road_labels),
  `Nearer (m)`=round(nearer_m),`Farther (m)`=round(farther_m)) %>% knitr::kable(format="pipe")
```

For the reported contrasts, a source/cover group must span both distances **within a similar distance range of the other road type**. Those other-road ranges are four baseline distance bands. Result 2 additionally requires locations from 25 to 75 m outside the old forest at both road-distance ends. We report the resulting reference areas with each result. These checks reduce extrapolation; they do not make every environmental condition identical.

The model uses log(1 + distance), with each road distance interacting with source distance. Other continuous environmental adjustments are linear. The main linear model includes all eligible land, including groups with no gain. It estimates adjusted differences, not absolute conversion probabilities. A bounded fractional-logit model checks this choice on groups with some conversion.

The 100 m window follows the scale used in an earlier eucalyptus mapping study. The 200 m check, road quartiles and 25-to-75 m comparison are analysis choices, not known limits to seed travel. Climate values are long-term averages, not local weather during dispersal.

\newpage

## Result 1

**Is mapped eucalyptus gain greater near roads?** First, the observed percentage uses new eucalyptus area divided by all eligible land in that distance band.

```{r}
#| label: selected-raw-rates
#| fig-height: 2.7
#| fig-width: 6.4
ggplot(raw_road,aes(road_band,gain_pct)) +
  geom_col(fill="#326B7B",width=.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%.2f%%",gain_pct)),vjust=-.4,size=3.4) +
  facet_wrap(~Road,nrow=1) + scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.22))) +
  labs(x="Baseline road-distance group",y="Observed mapped gain (%)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=10) + theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),axis.text.x=element_text(size=8))
```

These bars do not control for the surrounding land. After adjusting for the source forest, original cover, measured environment and the other road type, the **nearer-minus-farther** differences were:

```{r}
#| label: selected-result1-table
result_table("Result 1")
```

Positive values would support more gain nearer roads. Both estimates are small and negative, but **both uncertainty intervals include zero and positive values**. The data therefore do not give clear support for greater gain near either road group. They also do not establish that roads reduce gain or have no effect.

The two rows use different supported reference areas and reference distances. Their effect sizes should not be ranked as if they were the same experiment. The area denominators account for the fact that more land may be available far from a road.

\newpage

## Result 2

**Does gain decline less with distance from old eucalyptus near roads?** The graph below shows observed change before environmental adjustment.

```{r}
#| label: selected-source-distance
#| fig-height: 3.0
#| fig-width: 6.4
plot_distance <- raw_rates %>% mutate(midpoint=c("0-25"=12.5,"25-50"=37.5,"50-75"=62.5,"75-100"=87.5)[source_band])
ggplot(plot_distance,aes(midpoint,gain_pct,colour=road_band,shape=road_band)) +
  geom_line(linewidth=.65) + geom_point(size=2) + facet_wrap(~Road,nrow=1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("#2166AC","#777777","#B35806")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(12.5,37.5,62.5,87.5),labels=c("0-25","25-50","50-75","75-100")) +
  labs(x="Distance from old eucalyptus (m)",y="Observed mapped gain (%)",colour=NULL,shape=NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=10) + theme(legend.position="bottom",panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),axis.text.x=element_text(size=8),panel.spacing.x=grid::unit(1.8,"lines"))
```

For the adjusted test, we measure the change from **25 to 75 m outside old eucalyptus** at each reference road distance. We then subtract the farther-road change from the nearer-road change. A positive value agrees with the prediction that mapped gain declines less near roads.

```{r}
#| label: selected-result2-table
result_table("Result 2")
```

The traffic-road estimate is slightly positive and the access-route estimate slightly negative. Both intervals cover zero and both directions. **Neither gives a clear road-related difference in the distance pattern.** This describes mapped forest conversion, not how far individual seeds travelled.

\newpage

## Result 3

**On baseline pine land covered by fire, was eucalyptus conversion greater near roads?**

```{r}
#| label: selected-burned-pine
#| include: false
fire_file <- file.path(analysis_cache,"fire.rds")
if (!file.exists(fire_file)) {
# Rebuild the unchanged burned 2018 maritime-pine area and environmental values.
# input(name) points to the review's flat Raw Data directory.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(sf); library(terra); library(dplyr)})
f3_land18 <- read_sf(input('land_cover.gpkg'), 'land2018')
f3_pine18 <- f3_land18 %>% filter(cover_code == '5.1.2.1') %>% select(pine_id = source_id)
f3_fires <- read_sf(input('fires.gpkg'), 'fires') %>%
  filter(between(year, 2019, 2024)) %>% select(year, event_id)
f3_pieces <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(f3_pine18, f3_fires)) %>%
  filter(as.numeric(st_area(.)) > 1e-6)
f3_pieces <- suppressWarnings(st_collection_extract(f3_pieces, 'POLYGON'))
f3_pieces <- f3_pieces %>% group_by(pine_id, year, event_id) %>% summarise(.groups = 'drop')
f3_euc25 <- read_sf(input('land_cover.gpkg'), 'euc2025')
f3_pine25 <- read_sf(input('pine2025.gpkg'), 'pine2025')
f3_euc18 <- read_sf(input('land_cover.gpkg'), 'euc2018')
f3_study <- read_sf(input('land_cover.gpkg'), 'study_area')
f3_bounds <- st_bbox(f3_study)
f3_grid <- rast(xmin = 20 * floor(f3_bounds['xmin'] / 20), xmax = 20 * ceiling(f3_bounds['xmax'] / 20),
  ymin = 20 * floor(f3_bounds['ymin'] / 20), ymax = 20 * ceiling(f3_bounds['ymax'] / 20),
  resolution = 20, crs = 'EPSG:3763')
values(f3_grid) <- 1
# Construct only cells intersecting a fire/pine polygon, rather than a national grid.
f3_hit <- terra::extract(f3_grid, vect(f3_pieces), cells = TRUE, exact = TRUE)
f3_cells <- sort(unique(f3_hit$cell[!is.na(f3_hit$cell)]))
f3_xy <- xyFromCell(f3_grid, f3_cells)
f3_square <- function(i) {
  x <- f3_xy[i, 1]; y <- f3_xy[i, 2]
  st_polygon(list(matrix(c(x-10,y-10, x+10,y-10, x+10,y+10, x-10,y+10, x-10,y-10), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE)))
}
f3_cell_sf <- st_sf(cell = f3_cells, geometry = st_sfc(lapply(seq_along(f3_cells), f3_square), crs = 3763))
f3_units <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(f3_pieces, f3_cell_sf)) %>%
  group_by(cell, pine_id, year, event_id) %>% summarise(.groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(eligible_ha = as.numeric(st_area(.)) / 10000) %>% filter(eligible_ha > 1e-10) %>%
  mutate(unit_id = row_number())
f3_outcome <- function(cover) {
  suppressWarnings(st_intersection(f3_units %>% select(unit_id), st_geometry(cover))) %>%
    mutate(area_ha = as.numeric(st_area(.)) / 10000) %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(unit_id) %>% summarise(area_ha = sum(area_ha), .groups = 'drop')
}
f3_units <- f3_units %>%
  left_join(rename(f3_outcome(f3_euc25), euc25_ha = area_ha), by = 'unit_id') %>%
  left_join(rename(f3_outcome(f3_pine25), pine25_ha = area_ha), by = 'unit_id') %>%
  mutate(euc25_ha = coalesce(euc25_ha, 0), pine25_ha = coalesce(pine25_ha, 0))
# Remove only floating-point overlap noise, less than 0.0001 square metres.
f3_units$euc25_ha[f3_units$euc25_ha < 1e-8] <- 0
stopifnot(abs(sum(f3_units$eligible_ha) - sum(as.numeric(st_area(f3_pieces))) / 10000) < 1e-6,
  all(f3_units$euc25_ha <= f3_units$eligible_ha + 1e-8),
  all(f3_units$pine25_ha + f3_units$euc25_ha <= f3_units$eligible_ha + 1e-8),
  !anyDuplicated(st_drop_geometry(f3_units)[c('cell','event_id','pine_id')]))
# Geometry arithmetic can exceed a cell's area by a few floating-point digits.
f3_rounding <- tibble(units=sum(f3_units$euc25_ha>f3_units$eligible_ha),
  area_ha=sum(pmax(f3_units$euc25_ha-f3_units$eligible_ha,0)))
f3_units$euc25_ha <- pmin(f3_units$euc25_ha,f3_units$eligible_ha)
f3_points <- suppressWarnings(st_point_on_surface(f3_units))
f3_distance <- function(features) {
  nearest <- st_nearest_feature(f3_points, features)
  as.numeric(st_distance(st_geometry(f3_points), st_geometry(features)[nearest], by_element = TRUE))
}
f3_units$forest_m <- f3_distance(f3_euc18)
f3_nearest_euc <- st_nearest_feature(f3_points, f3_euc18)
f3_units$euc18_id <- f3_euc18$source_id[f3_nearest_euc]
f3_point_xy <- st_coordinates(f3_points)
f3_units$x_m <- f3_point_xy[,1]; f3_units$y_m <- f3_point_xy[,2]

# Rebuild the same nine environmental layers on the existing 20 m accounting grid.
f3_dem <- rast(input('copernicus_glo30.tif'))
f3_dem_extent <- ext(vect(st_transform(f3_study, crs(f3_dem))))
f3_dem <- crop(f3_dem, extend(f3_dem_extent, 2 * res(f3_dem)[1]), snap='out')
f3_slope <- terrain(f3_dem, v='slope', unit='degrees', neighbors=8)
f3_align <- function(layer) terra::project(layer, f3_grid, method='near')
f3_history <- read_sf(input('fires.gpkg'), 'fires') %>% filter(year==2017)
f3_env <- c(f3_align(c(f3_dem, f3_slope)), f3_align(rast(input('climate.tif'))),
  f3_align(rast(input('forest_management_2015.tif'))),
  rasterize(vect(f3_history), f3_grid, field=1, background=0),
  f3_align(rast(input('fire_dnbr_2017.tif'))), f3_align(rast(input('fire_confidence_2017.tif'))))
names(f3_env) <- c('elevation','slope','temperature','rain','wind','management','burned','severity','quality')
f3_environment <- terra::extract(f3_env, vect(f3_points)) %>% select(-ID)
f3_data <- bind_cols(st_drop_geometry(f3_units), f3_environment) %>%
  mutate(gain_fraction=euc25_ha/eligible_ha, log_forest=log1p(forest_m),
    planted=if_else(is.na(management),NA_integer_,as.integer(management %in% c(31,32))),
    severity_2017=if_else(burned==0,0,if_else(quality>0,severity,NA_real_)))


# Input: the unchanged exact fire/pine fragments and the selected 2018 road lines.
# No cell-level standard errors: only three fires have mapped eucalyptus gain.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(sf); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2)})

f3_weighted_quantile <- function(x, w, probabilities = c(.25, .75)) {
  ordered <- order(x)
  x <- x[ordered]; cumulative <- cumsum(w[ordered]) / sum(w)
  vapply(probabilities, function(p) x[which(cumulative >= p)[1]], numeric(1))
}

f3_in_hull <- function(observed, query) {
  boundary <- unique(observed[chull(observed), , drop = FALSE])
  if (nrow(boundary) < 3) return(rep(FALSE, nrow(query)))
  boundary <- rbind(boundary, boundary[1, ])
  products <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(boundary) - 1), function(i) {
    (boundary[i+1,1] - boundary[i,1]) * (query[,2] - boundary[i,2]) -
      (boundary[i+1,2] - boundary[i,2]) * (query[,1] - boundary[i,1])
  }, numeric(nrow(query)))
  apply(products >= -1e-10, 1, all) | apply(products <= 1e-10, 1, all)
}

f3_fit_selected <- function(data, variables) {
  complete <- data %>% filter(if_all(all_of(variables), ~ is.finite(.x)))
  groups <- complete %>% group_by(event_id) %>%
    summarise(land_ha = sum(eligible_ha), gain_ha = sum(euc25_ha),
      traffic_range = diff(range(log_traffic)), access_range = diff(range(log_access)), .groups = 'drop')
  supported <- groups %>% filter(gain_ha > 1e-8, gain_ha < land_ha - 1e-8,
    traffic_range > 1e-8, access_range > 1e-8)
  selected <- complete %>% filter(event_id %in% supported$event_id) %>%
    mutate(event_id = factor(event_id))
  terms <- c(variables, if (nlevels(selected$event_id) > 1) 'event_id')
  fit <- glm(reformulate(terms, response = 'gain_fraction'), data = selected,
    family = quasibinomial(), weights = eligible_ha, control = glm.control(maxit = 100))
  list(model = fit, data = selected, groups = groups,
    counts = tibble(events = nrow(supported), land_ha = sum(selected$eligible_ha),
      gain_ha = sum(selected$euc25_ha), units = nrow(selected), converged = fit$converged,
      finite_coefficients = all(is.finite(coef(fit))), rank = fit$rank,
      coefficients = length(coef(fit)),
      traffic_coefficient = unname(coef(fit)['log_traffic']),
      access_coefficient = unname(coef(fit)['log_access'])))
}

f3_contrast <- function(fitted, reference) {
  bind_rows(lapply(c('traffic', 'access'), function(road) {
    distance <- paste0(road, '_m'); log_distance <- paste0('log_', road)
    near <- reference$near_m[reference$road == road]
    far <- reference$far_m[reference$road == road]
    range_support <- fitted$data %>% group_by(event_id) %>%
      summarise(min_m = min(.data[[distance]]), max_m = max(.data[[distance]]), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      filter(min_m <= near, max_m >= far)
    target <- fitted$data %>% filter(event_id %in% range_support$event_id)
    if (nrow(target) == 0) return(tibble(road = road, near_m = near, far_m = far,
      events = 0L, land_ha = 0, gain_ha = 0, near_pct = NA_real_, far_pct = NA_real_,
      difference_pp = NA_real_, outside_road_hull_pct = NA_real_,
      joint_supported_ha = 0, joint_supported_difference_pp = NA_real_))
    near_data <- far_data <- target
    near_data[[log_distance]] <- log1p(near)
    far_data[[log_distance]] <- log1p(far)
    near_prediction <- predict(fitted$model, newdata = near_data, type = 'response')
    far_prediction <- predict(fitted$model, newdata = far_data, type = 'response')
    near_pct <- 100 * weighted.mean(near_prediction, target$eligible_ha)
    far_pct <- 100 * weighted.mean(far_prediction, target$eligible_ha)
    joint_ok <- rep(FALSE, nrow(target))
    for (fire in unique(as.character(target$event_id))) {
      rows <- which(as.character(target$event_id) == fire)
      observed <- fitted$data %>% filter(as.character(event_id) == fire) %>%
        select(log_traffic, log_access) %>% as.matrix()
      near_xy <- as.matrix(near_data[rows, c('log_traffic', 'log_access')])
      far_xy <- as.matrix(far_data[rows, c('log_traffic', 'log_access')])
      joint_ok[rows] <- f3_in_hull(observed, near_xy) & f3_in_hull(observed, far_xy)
    }
    tibble(road = road, near_m = near, far_m = far, events = nrow(range_support),
      land_ha = sum(target$eligible_ha), gain_ha = sum(target$euc25_ha),
      near_pct = near_pct, far_pct = far_pct, difference_pp = near_pct - far_pct,
      outside_road_hull_pct = 100 * weighted.mean(!joint_ok, target$eligible_ha),
      joint_supported_ha = sum(target$eligible_ha[joint_ok]),
      joint_supported_difference_pp = if (any(joint_ok)) 100 *
        weighted.mean((near_prediction - far_prediction)[joint_ok], target$eligible_ha[joint_ok]) else NA_real_)
  }))
}

f3_selected_analysis <- function(base_data, roads) {
  stopifnot(all(c('traffic', 'access') %in% roads$group), st_crs(roads)$epsg == 3763,
    all(base_data$eligible_ha > 0), all(base_data$gain_fraction >= 0), all(base_data$gain_fraction <= 1))
  points <- st_as_sf(base_data, coords = c('x_m', 'y_m'), remove = FALSE, crs = 3763)
  distance_to <- function(lines) {
    nearest <- st_nearest_feature(points, lines)
    as.numeric(st_distance(st_geometry(points), st_geometry(lines)[nearest], by_element = TRUE))
  }
  data <- base_data %>% mutate(traffic_m = distance_to(filter(roads, group == 'traffic')),
    access_m = distance_to(filter(roads, group == 'access')),
    log_traffic = log1p(traffic_m), log_access = log1p(access_m), log_forest = log1p(forest_m))
  reference <- bind_rows(lapply(c('traffic', 'access'), function(road) {
    q <- f3_weighted_quantile(data[[paste0(road, '_m')]], data$eligible_ha)
    tibble(road = road, near_m = q[1], far_m = q[2], reference_ha = sum(data$eligible_ha))
  }))
  variables <- list(distance = c('log_traffic', 'log_access', 'log_forest'),
    terrain = c('log_traffic', 'log_access', 'log_forest', 'elevation', 'slope'),
    full = c('log_traffic', 'log_access', 'log_forest', 'elevation', 'slope',
      'temperature', 'rain', 'wind', 'planted', 'severity_2017'))
  fits <- lapply(variables, function(v) f3_fit_selected(data, v))
  same_sample <- f3_fit_selected(fits$full$data, variables$distance)
  fits$distance_on_full_sample <- same_sample
  model_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(fits, '[[', 'counts'), .id = 'model')
  contrasts <- bind_rows(lapply(fits, f3_contrast, reference = reference), .id = 'model')
  informative <- levels(fits$distance$data$event_id)
  loo_fits <- setNames(lapply(informative, function(fire) {
    f3_fit_selected(filter(data, event_id != fire), variables$distance)
  }), informative)
  loo <- bind_rows(lapply(loo_fits, '[[', 'counts'), .id = 'left_out')
  loo_contrasts <- bind_rows(lapply(loo_fits, f3_contrast, reference = reference), .id = 'left_out')
  event_fits <- setNames(lapply(informative, function(fire) {
    f3_fit_selected(filter(data, event_id == fire), variables$distance)
  }), informative)
  event_estimates <- bind_rows(lapply(event_fits, '[[', 'counts'), .id = 'event_id')
  event_contrasts <- bind_rows(lapply(event_fits, f3_contrast, reference = reference), .id = 'event_id')
  by_event <- data %>% group_by(year, event_id) %>%
    summarise(land_ha = sum(eligible_ha), gain_ha = sum(euc25_ha), retained_pine_ha = sum(pine25_ha),
      changed_pct = 100 * gain_ha / land_ha, units = n(),
      across(c(traffic_m, access_m, forest_m), list(min = min, max = max,
        mean = ~ weighted.mean(.x, eligible_ha))), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    rename(eligible_ha = land_ha, euc25_ha = gain_ha, pine25_ha = retained_pine_ha)
  summary <- tibble(fires = nrow(by_event), pine_ha = sum(data$eligible_ha),
    gain_ha = sum(data$euc25_ha), still_pine_ha = sum(data$pine25_ha), units = nrow(data),
    with_gain = sum(by_event$euc25_ha > 1e-8),
    largest_gain_share = 100 * max(by_event$euc25_ha) / sum(by_event$euc25_ha))
  # Unknown service and explicit restrictions are diagnosed when supplied in the road layer.
  road_sets <- list(track_only = filter(roads, group == 'traffic' | highway == 'track'))
  if ('access_unknown' %in% names(roads)) road_sets$no_unknown_service <-
    filter(roads, group == 'traffic' | !access_unknown)
  if ('explicit_motor_no' %in% names(roads)) road_sets$no_explicit_motor_ban <-
    filter(roads, !explicit_motor_no)
  sensitivity <- lapply(road_sets, function(lines) {
    changed <- data %>% mutate(traffic_m = distance_to(filter(lines, group == 'traffic')),
      access_m = distance_to(filter(lines, group == 'access')),
      log_traffic = log1p(traffic_m), log_access = log1p(access_m))
    fitted <- f3_fit_selected(changed, variables$distance)
    list(fit = fitted, contrast = f3_contrast(fitted, reference))
  })
  sensitivity_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(sensitivity, function(x) x$fit$counts), .id = 'definition')
  sensitivity_contrasts <- bind_rows(lapply(sensitivity, '[[', 'contrast'), .id = 'definition')
  support <- fits$distance$data %>% group_by(event_id) %>%
    summarise(land_ha = sum(eligible_ha), gain_ha = sum(euc25_ha),
      across(c(elevation, slope, temperature, rain, wind, planted, severity_2017),
        list(min = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE), max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
          missing_ha = ~ sum(eligible_ha[!is.finite(.x)]))),
      traffic_access_correlation = cor(log_traffic, log_access), .groups = 'drop')
  list(data = data, by_event = by_event, summary = summary, reference = reference, fits = fits,
    model_summary = model_summary, contrasts = contrasts, loo = loo, loo_contrasts = loo_contrasts,
    event_estimates = event_estimates, event_contrasts = event_contrasts, sensitivity = sensitivity,
    sensitivity_summary = sensitivity_summary, sensitivity_contrasts = sensitivity_contrasts, support = support)
}

f3 <- f3_selected_analysis(f3_data,read_sf(input("roads2018_selected.gpkg"),"roads"))
saveRDS(f3,fire_file)
}
f3 <- readRDS(fire_file)
```

The same 18 fire footprints from 2019--2024 overlap **176.23 ha of maritime-pine land** mapped in 2018. In 2025, **17.33 ha** is mapped as eucalyptus. Only **three fires** contain this change. The model compares places within each of these fires, controlling both road distances and distance to old eucalyptus. The other 15 fires remain in the area totals but cannot estimate a finite within-fire logistic relationship.

For traffic roads the comparison is `r round(f3$reference$near_m[1])` versus `r round(f3$reference$far_m[1])` m; for land-access routes it is `r round(f3$reference$near_m[2])` versus `r round(f3$reference$far_m[2])` m. These quartiles come from all baseline burned-pine land. Each contrast keeps the other road distance observed and uses fires spanning both distances. Each displayed comparison is supported by only two fires.

```{r}
#| label: selected-fire-models
#| fig-height: 3.1
#| fig-width: 6.4
fire_plot <- f3$contrasts %>% filter(model %in% c("distance","terrain","full")) %>%
  mutate(Road=recode(road,!!!road_labels),
    Adjustment=factor(model,levels=c("full","terrain","distance"),labels=c("Full environment","+ Terrain","Source distance")))
ggplot(fire_plot,aes(difference_pp,Adjustment)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0,colour="grey65") + geom_point(size=2.5,colour="#326B7B") +
  geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%.2f",difference_pp)),vjust=-.8,size=3) +
  facet_wrap(~Road,ncol=1) + scale_x_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(.12,.12))) +
  labs(x="Nearer minus farther (percentage points)",y=NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=9) + theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank())
```

These estimates do not show more conversion near either road group. However, **one 2019 fire contains 85.8% of the change**. Removing it reverses the traffic-road difference to +17.99 percentage points; only one remaining fire supports that distance contrast. We report no cell-based confidence intervals or p values: three changing fires are too few for reliable regional inference.

The terrain check adds elevation and slope. The full check also adds climate, the 2015 planting label and 2017 fire severity, using 148.21 ha with complete data. Current-fire severity is missing. These maps cannot establish whether planting, mixed stands or natural recruitment explain the change, or whether the pine-to-eucalyptus switch happened before or after the fire. There is no unburned control for a fire effect.

\newpage

## Checks and limits

The following checks keep the same baseline reference distances. All entries are percentage-point differences. T = traffic roads; A = land-access routes. Result 1 is nearer minus farther. Result 2 is the difference in the 25-to-75 m source-distance change.

```{r}
#| label: selected-sensitivity-table
sensitivity %>% filter(block=="block2" | block=="point estimate only") %>%
  mutate(Analysis=recode(model,`Joint roads, 100 m`="Main, 100 m",`Joint roads, 200 m`="Wider, 200 m",
    `Tracks as access routes`="Tracks only for access",`No unknown service subtype`="No unknown services",
    `No explicit motor bans`="No motor bans",`Fractional logit, informative land`="Bounded, changing groups",
    `Linear model, same informative land`="Linear, same groups"),
    key=paste0(ifelse(road=="traffic","T","A"),ifelse(result=="Result 1","1","2")),value=pp(estimate)) %>%
  select(Analysis,key,value) %>% pivot_wider(names_from=key,values_from=value) %>%
  select(Analysis,T1,A1,T2,A2) %>% knitr::kable(format="pipe",align=c("l","r","r","r","r"))
```

Changing the road definition did not reveal a stable positive relationship. The bounded model uses only 367 source/cover groups with some conversion: 7,575 ha from 291 source features. The last row fits the linear model to exactly that same land. This separates a change in sample from a change in model. The bounded row gives point estimates only.

The main linear model puts **`r sprintf("%.1f",diagnostics$weighted_outside_0_1_pct[1])`%** of fitted land area outside the 0--1 range. This limits its use to adjusted differences, not absolute predictions. We did not clip predictions. The distance relationships and environmental adjustments are model assumptions, not experimentally verified controls.

Uncertainty allows shared source features and shared 2 km geographic blocks. Using 1 km and 4 km blocks also left all four primary intervals spanning zero. The 4 km covariance calculation needed a numerical correction, which widened the traffic-road intervals. The main 2 km calculation did not need it. These block sizes handle correlated errors; they are not seed-dispersal distances. Deleting one source at a time gave Result 1 ranges of -0.26 to +0.05 points (traffic) and -0.57 to -0.06 (access). Result 2 stayed +0.04 to +0.11 (traffic) and -0.10 to -0.02 (access). These are influence checks, not uncertainty intervals.

**Several explanations remain open.** Road access may support planting, harvesting and replanting as well as natural recruitment. Pine-labelled forest can already contain eucalyptus; fire and resprouting may change the dominant cover. Farming and abandonment, soils, drainage, weather during seed release, road maintenance and traffic are not fully measured. The coarse 2015 planting label does not verify whether a particular new patch was planted.

Seven years can reveal mapped cover change, but not every new seedling becomes detectable. COS includes young stands capable of reaching forest conditions and does not count individual trees. Across the road definitions, distance windows and models checked here, we did not find stable support for either original prediction. Some estimates point in the predicted direction, but uncertainty or model sensitivity prevents a clear conclusion. This does not cover every possible method or show that roads have no effect. The maps measure forest-cover change, not natural seed dispersal itself.

## Data sources

- **Land cover and the pilot road.** Direção-Geral do Território (DGT), COS Series 2, [2018 v4](https://ogcapi.dgterritorio.gov.pt/collections/cos2018v4) and [2025 v1](https://ogcapi.dgterritorio.gov.pt/collections/cos2025v1). The maps use eucalyptus class 5.1.1.6 and maritime pine class 5.1.2.1. The regional `pine2025.gpkg` file contains the 2025 maritime-pine polygons clipped to the same study area. [DGT class definitions and imagery dates](https://geo2.dgterritorio.gov.pt/cos/ET/COS-Serie2-EspecificacoesTecnicas.pdf). [DGT, CC BY 4.0](https://www.dgterritorio.gov.pt/dados-abertos)
- **Regional roads.** The original network is retained in `roads.gpkg`. The revised `roads2018_selected.gpkg` comes from the 1 January 2018 archive and separates traffic roads from tracks and selected service roads. Private access is retained. © OpenStreetMap contributors. [Geofabrik archive](https://download.geofabrik.de/europe/portugal.html); [track](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tag:highway%3Dtrack), [service](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tag:highway%3Dservice) and [access definitions](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:access); [ODbL 1.0](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright).
- **Pilot aerial photos.** DGT imagery from 2018 and 2025, exported at 2 m for area B. [DGT orthophotos, CC BY 4.0](https://www.dgterritorio.gov.pt/atividades/cartografia/cartografia-topografica/ortofotos/ortofotos-digitais)
- **Pilot climate.** WorldClim v2.1, temperature and rainfall averages for 1970–2000. [WorldClim](https://www.worldclim.org/data/worldclim21.html) · [Fick and Hijmans (2017)](https://doi.org/10.1002/joc.5086)
- **Regional climate.** CHELSA v2.1, temperature, rainfall and mean near-surface wind speed for 1981–2010. [CHELSA](https://www.chelsa-climate.org/datasets/chelsa_bioclim) · [BIOCLIM+ data, CC0](https://doi.org/10.16904/envidat.332)
- **Elevation and slope.** Copernicus DEM GLO-30, tile N40/W009. [Product and licence](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/explore-data/data-collections/copernicus-contributing-missions/collections-description/COP-DEM)
- **Fire.** ICNF, *Áreas ardidas*, 2017–2025, retrieved 5 November 2026. [Fire perimeters](https://sigservices.icnf.pt/server/rest/services/BDG/areas_ardidas/FeatureServer) · [ICNF terms](https://geocatalogo.icnf.pt/dados/condicoes_utilizacao.pdf). The 2017 burn severity and image quality layers come from Jahanianfard et al. [Portuguese Burn Severity Atlas v2, CC BY 4.0](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15188051)
